meta.name: sales-enablement
meta.description: When the user wants to create sales collateral, pitch decks, one-pagers, objection handling docs, or demo scripts. Also use when the user mentions 'sales deck,' 'pitch deck,' 'one-pager,' 'leave-behind,' 'objection handling,' 'deal-specific ROI analysis,' 'demo script,' 'talk track,' 'sales playbook,' 'proposal template,' 'buyer persona card,' 'help my sales team,' 'sales materials,' or 'what should I give my sales reps.' Use this for any document or asset that helps a sales team close deals. For competitor comparison pages and battle cards, see competitors. For marketing website copy, see copywriting. For cold outreach emails, see cold-email. For the offer being sold (bonuses, guarantees, pricing structure), see offers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成销售资料和演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为销售团队制作各类销售辅助材料。
copy.tagline_en: Create sales collateral and pitch decks quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce sales enablement materials for your team.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会帮你写销售资料，比如演示文稿、一页纸、反对意见应对文档、演示脚本和销售手册。它会先检查有没有产品营销背景信息，然后问你几个问题来了解你的产品、销售方式和具体需求。
howto.when: 当你提到“销售资料”、“演示文稿”、“一页纸”、“反对意见应对”等关键词，或者要求“帮我的销售团队”时触发。也适用于任何帮助销售团队成交的文档或资产。

say.text: 帮我写一份针对CTO的销售演示文稿，10页左右。
写一份反对意见应对文档，针对“太贵了”这个反对意见。
say.note: Claude 会按框架给出反对意见、回应、证明点和跟进问题。

say.text: 帮我写一份会后跟进的一页纸，客户是制造业的。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you create sales collateral such as pitch decks, one-pagers, objection handling docs, demo scripts, and playbooks. It first checks for existing product marketing context, then asks questions about your product, sales motion, and specific needs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'sales deck,' 'pitch deck,' 'one-pager,' 'objection handling,' or 'help my sales team,' or when you request any document that helps a sales team close deals.

say_en.text: Write a pitch deck for a CTO, about 10 slides.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the 10-12 slide framework and tailor for technical buyers.

say_en.text: Create an objection handling doc for 'too expensive.'
say_en.note: Claude will provide objection, response, proof point, and follow-up question.

say_en.text: Write a post-meeting one-pager for a manufacturing client.
